title: Orange-reddish wobbling UFOs around Area 51

tellings.quote: Okay, so there are orange-reddish UFOs that have been flying around Area 51 since the '80s and '90s that wobble like they're on a wave at low altitudes.

plain: Orange-reddish UFOs have been flying low around Area 51, the secret test site in the Nevada desert, since the 1980s and 1990s, and they wobble as if they were riding a wave. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about the two days he spent with Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft near the base.
